name: Riverpaw pack
summary: In Elwynn and Westfall, the Riverpaw pack raids farms and roads and rules local kobolds. Since the Third War, its attacks have grown bolder and better organized as Stormwind's forces are stretched thin.

sections.title: A Plague on the Heartland
sections.body:
For decades, Riverpaw gnolls stayed near the edges of human lands. In recent years, their raids have grown bolder. In Elwynn Forest, packs led by the infamous brute Hogger prowl the southern woods around Forest's Edge and the shores of Stone Cairn Lake. In Westfall, they cross the Dust Plains and coast, ambushing lone travelers and raiding homesteads.

Deputy Rainer at Westbrook Garrison and Captain Danuvin at Sentinel Hill rely on mercenaries to thin their ranks. They offer standing bounties for painted armbands and severed paws.

sections.title: Merciless Taskmasters
sections.body:
The Riverpaws seek more than easy prey. They drove a clan of kobolds from the Redridge Mountains and forced them to work in gold mines across Elwynn Forest and Westfall. There, the kobolds labor for ore until exhaustion.

Their hold over the kobolds and the mines shows a clan gathering wealth and pressing into strategic ground. Stormwind's attention is elsewhere.

sections.title: Shadows and Gold
sections.body: Ledgers and documents recovered from the Riverpaw pack point to dealings with the Defias Brotherhood. The Stormwind Army first dismissed the gnolls as an animal nuisance. Now Wiley the Black and Captain Danuvin know the pack receives money and direction as part of an effort to destabilize the kingdom.

faq.answer: Hogger, a massive and ferocious gnoll, is the Riverpaw pack's most infamous leader. He stalks the southwestern woods of Elwynn Forest near Forest's Edge, and Stormwind authorities offer a great bounty for his head.
Riverpaw gnolls roam southwestern Elwynn Forest around Forest's Edge and Stone Cairn Lake. They also cross Westfall's Dust Plains and coastline.

faq.q: Why are the Riverpaw gnolls working with the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Recovered documents show payments passing between the Riverpaw clan and the Defias Brotherhood. The Defias fund and equip the gnolls to spread chaos, plunder resources, and keep local militias occupied across Westfall and Elwynn. This weakens Stormwind's defenses.

faq.q: Why are kobolds working in the gold mines near the Riverpaw?
aliases: why do gnolls have kobold slaves
faq.answer: The Riverpaw gnolls drove a clan of Redridge kobolds from their home and enslaved them in mines across Elwynn Forest and Westfall. The gnolls force them to dig for gold to fuel their war efforts.

faq.q: Why hasn't the Stormwind Army wiped out the Riverpaw pack?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military is stretched thin, and rural garrisons such as Sentinel Hill and Westbrook receive few reinforcements. Local marshals rely on passing adventurers and militia bounties to keep Riverpaw numbers in check.

faq.q: What is the historical relationship between the Riverpaws and Stormwind?
faq.answer: The Riverpaws have clashed with Stormwind for generations. Since the Third War, they have grown bolder and more organized, raiding farms and roads in Elwynn and Westfall while the kingdom's soldiers are stretched thin.

angles.text: The Riverpaws threaten the Alliance heartland and disrupt trade between Goldshire, Westfall, and Redridge. Stormwind's armies are absent.
For farmers and homesteaders in Westfall and Elwynn, the Riverpaws threaten their homes. They slaughter families, steal livestock, and seize local mines.
Town marshals offer warriors coin and prestige to hunt Riverpaw brutes in the brush and challenge their warlords, including Hogger.
Rogues can intercept Riverpaw messengers to learn how criminal syndicates direct the gnolls' violence and uncover intelligence on the Defias network.
